name: Dual Marching Cubes with GPU Mesh Simplification
aliases: Dual Marching Cubes (DMC) with GPU Mesh Simplification
Parallel Dual Marching Cube with Simplification
definition: A parallel isosurface extraction method that computes cell intersections using an asymptotic decider to resolve ambiguities, outputting a quadrilateral mesh stored in a halfedge data structure.
